donors.transfer: Separate learned head with frozen parent, group-excluded training, immutable calibration and no production admission.
Source-group exclusion, same-path votes are correlated features not independent proofs.
Soft common trajectory support; no exact SAT-style rejection on noisy data.
Do not treat correlated trial maxima as independent; fixed family and one result per group. Formal historywise null bound deferred until valid conditional caps exist.
Future matched-filter evidence accumulation; PCM resonator itself not reused in intensity spectra.
Future soft graph posterior/flow; dense hydraulic solver not imported into spectrogram.

train: Four leave-one-evaluation-group-out folds; train on the other 3 eval and shared groups, separately calibrate on 2 historical null groups, test held eval and held shared; no test labels in features, fitting, calibration or choice of arm. Exact raw tile disjointness enforced, overlap within a group retained. Not a fresh or independent exam.
features: Per-candidate detector score, path support within 2 bins on >=12 rows, trace mean/std/quantiles/block sums, local sideband difference, drift roughness, patch profile concentration; path classifier trained on localized injected paths, not arbitrary candidate origin. Preserve candidate paths and all raw R28 scores.
calibration: fixed empirical 5% patch-control budget on two distinct historical calibration groups; fused score max of normalized frozen and learned margins, recalibrated; retain R35G original R28 threshold. No survey-level null claim.
gate: strict increase in weak localized, strict reduction control alerts, no aggregate localized loss, no shared localized loss; report per-group regressions and paired additions/losses. Any pass is development only.
